headline: 2 killed, 10 injured as bus hits 3 vehicles in Mymensingh
summary: The accident occurred on the Dhaka-Mymensingh highway in Trishal upazila when a bus attempted to overtake another vehicle.
details: Two people were killed and 10 others were injured when a bus struck three vehicles from behind in the Kazirshimla area of Trishal upazila, Mymensingh.
The victims, both male passengers of a CNG-run auto-rickshaw, were declared dead at the Trishal Upazila Health Complex.

According to Monsur Ahammad, officer-in-charge of Trishal Police Station, the accident happened around 7:15 am today as a Mymensingh-bound bus from Dhaka hit two human haulers and a CNG-run auto-rickshaw while overtaking.
Twelve passengers in total were injured and rushed to the Trishal Upazila Health Complex, with the remaining injured later referred to Mymensingh Medical College Hospital.
Police have seized the bus involved in the collision, but the driver managed to flee the scene.
A legal case has been filed in connection with the incident, confirmed the police officer.
caption:

According to Monsur Ahammad, officer-in-charge of Trishal Police Station, the accident happened around 7:15 am today as a Mymensingh-bound bus from Dhaka hit two human haulers and a CNG-run auto-rickshaw while overtaking.

Twelve passengers in total were injured and rushed to the Trishal Upazila Health Complex, with the remaining injured later referred to Mymensingh Medical College Hospital.

Police have seized the bus involved in the collision, but the driver managed to flee the scene.

A legal case has been filed in connection with the incident, confirmed the police officer.

headline: Air Quality Alert: Dhaka ranks 4th in global air quality index
summary: The capital city faces severe pollution levels as it climbs to the top of the global rankings for worst air quality.
details: Dhaka has been ranked 4th in the global air quality index, indicating severe air pollution in the capital city.
The ranking highlights the critical state of environmental health in the city, where residents are exposed to high levels of pollutants.
Air quality indices typically measure particulate matter and other pollutants that can have significant health impacts on the population.
The city continues to struggle with various sources of pollution, including vehicle emissions, construction dust, and industrial waste.
